scope: Phase 01 Foundation Layer, Phase 02 AI Core, Phase 03 Memory System, and Phase 10 Goal Execution Engine. Other Omega phases remain planned coverage records until their evidence slices are created.
rules: Dependency records do not prove implementation.
KPI records are readiness measurements, not product performance claims.
Success metrics require evidence paths and validation gates before promotion.
No runtime autonomy, live provider, SSH, deployment, benchmark, model training, or public release is enabled by this record.

phaseEvidence.title: Memory System

dependencies.title: Memory privacy boundary
dependencies.nextAction: Define what may enter temporary, workspace, and user-approved persistent memory.

dependencies.title: Context and session handoff records

dependencies.title: Memory ranking and retrieval policy
dependencies.nextAction: Add ranking, compression, retrieval, and deletion rules before memory runtime behavior.

kpis.target: Memory records distinguish temporary context, workspace context, approved memory, and sensitive content.
kpis.currentEvidence: Boundary is planned; current records do not yet define a complete memory policy.

kpis.currentEvidence: General SEIS security rules exist; phase-specific memory exclusion policy remains planned.
